description: This file defines the Api class, which represents API-related data within the OrangeHRM installer utility. It extends a DataGroup class and includes properties and methods for handling API and module identifiers, as well as creating instances from arrays with permission checks.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Represents an API entity with properties for API name and module. Provides functionality to instantiate from an array, including validation, and accessors for its properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Api object with name, description, API identifier, module identifier, allowed permission, and permissions list.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static method to create an Api instance from provided data array, validating permissions and constructing permission objects.
